description: This file defines the Header class used in the reporting component of the OrangeHRM core plugin. It manages a collection of Column or StackedColumn objects and includes methods for adding, retrieving, normalizing, and managing metadata associated with report headers.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Represents a report header containing columns, with support for normalization and metadata management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Header with an array of Column or StackedColumn objects.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of columns associated with this header.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets multiple columns for this header, adding each through addColumn.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a single Column or StackedColumn to the header, validating its type.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns the header's columns as an array of their array representations.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves the optional metadata ParameterBag associated with the header.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the metadata ParameterBag for the header.
